verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships as a dependency-free C/C++ binary with pre-built releases (no Python/runtime stack to boot), and community evidence explicitly praises loading-time performance and trivial, fast setup on consumer hardware. However, there are no precise cold-start latency benchmarks comparing binary startup time itself (as opposed to model load/mmap behavior) to competing runtimes. missing for 10: explicit cold-start timing benchmarks, comparison to heavier runtimes' startup overhead.
